status: review-candidate (not approved, not registered, not served)
title: Comparing decimals: place value, not length
familyTitle: Comparing a tenths decimal with a hundredths decimal
skill: Compare a tenths decimal with a hundredths decimal by place value.

concept: Decimals are compared place by place from the left: wholes, then tenths, then hundredths.
Writing both with the same number of places makes them easy to compare: 0.7 = 0.70, which is more than 0.65.

visual.note: hundred grid: one shaded square = 0.01; a full column = 0.1

explanation.visualNote: Reuses the hundred grid ({type:'grid', rows:10, cols:10, shaded:k}) of the decimal-tenths module's hundred_grid strategy; shade each number on its own grid.

workedExamples.prompt: Which number is greater: 0.01 or 0.5? Write the greater number.
lines: Write both with two decimal places: 0.01 and 0.50
0.01 is 1 hundredth; 0.50 is 50 hundredths. So 0.5 is greater
familyExplainSteps: Compare the tenths: 5 and 0. The greater number is 0.5

workedExamples.prompt: Which number is greater: 3.1 or 3.42? Write the greater number.
lines: Write both with two decimal places: 3.10 and 3.42
3.10 is 310 hundredths; 3.42 is 342 hundredths. So 3.42 is greater
familyExplainSteps: Compare the tenths: 1 and 4. The greater number is 3.42

hints: Write both with two places: 0.01 and 0.50.
Write both with two places: 3.10 and 3.42.

alternativeExplanation.title: Number line in tenths
text: Find which tenth each number is in first; only if they are in the same tenth do the hundredths decide.

misconceptions.status: modelled (a single matching answer is a SUSPECTED error; established only under misconception-evidence@1: two matching answers)
misconceptions.note: digits after the point read as a whole number

whatWentWrong: In "Which number is greater: 2.2 or 2.01? Write the greater number.", one wrong answer is 2.01.
2.01 was taken as greater because it has more digits after the point. Compare the tenths first.
More digits after the point does not mean bigger: compare the tenths first.
screens.counterCheck: Counter-check: 0.5 is half; 0.45 is less than half (45 of 100). So 0.5 > 0.45 although 0.45 has more digits.
solvedCorrectly: Write both with two decimal places: 2.20 and 2.01
2.20 is 220 hundredths; 2.01 is 201 hundredths. So 2.2 is greater

misconceptions.status: modelled (a single matching answer is a SUSPECTED error; established only under misconception-evidence@1: two matching answers)

whatWentWrong: In "Which number is greater: 1.77 or 1.2? Write the greater number.", one wrong answer is 1.2.
1.2 was taken as greater because hundredths are small pieces; but 1.77 has more tenths (7 against 2).
A tenths number is not always bigger than a hundredths number: compare the tenths digits.
screens.counterCheck: Counter-check: 0.91 is 9 tenths and 1 hundredth; 0.1 is only 1 tenth. 0.91 > 0.1.
solvedCorrectly: Write both with two decimal places: 1.77 and 1.20
1.77 is 177 hundredths; 1.20 is 120 hundredths. So 1.77 is greater
